_what: English wording of the setup wizard (nx23, workstream Setup wizard): the cause first, then one action, at most two sentences. Only keys that no other workstream owns; ERR_TIMEOUT_RETRY is left as it is, because the app also shows it for sensors and remote controls: nx-patch.js words it for the Wi-Fi configuration only.
BRIDGE_SEARCH_TEXT: Looking for the accessory's own Wi-Fi network.
BRIDGE_NOT_FOUND_TEXT: No accessory Wi-Fi network was found. Check that the accessory is powered on and within a few metres of the phone.
ADD_DEVICE_LABEL_INFO_NO_DEVICES: Not listed? Check that your phone is on the same Wi-Fi as the accessory, with Location on and VPN and mobile data off. Use New accessory only for an accessory that is new or was reset.
DEVICE_CODE_TEXT: Enter the code printed on the label of the accessory.
NHK_ERROR-13: The accessory did not accept the Wi-Fi settings, most likely because of a wrong password. Check the password and try again.
LOCALIZATION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED_ERROR: Location is off, or this app is not allowed to use it. Android needs it to find nearby Wi-Fi networks: turn it on and try again.
ALERT_MESSAGE_WIFI_WRONG: The phone is not on your home Wi-Fi. Connect it to this network:
USER_PAIRING_MAX_USER_REACHED_MESSAGE: This accessory has reached its maximum number of users.
